messages:
alex (Support): Heads-up: MediHealth sent a 40‑page security/compliance questionnaire. They need SOC2 + HIPAA answers, audit log details, and data retention policy. Attaching doc. Can product own intake and prioritize?

raj (Sales): thanks alex. this is a deal blocker for them — they want answers before EOW. revenue motion: enterprise pilot + contract on table. 😬

maria (PM): added to intake. can you drop the doc link? I need to triage requirements vs. roadmap.

alex (Support): link: https://files.redwood/mh-qna-2026.pdf

taylor (Security): skimmed. key asks: 1) SOC2 controls mapping (current scope) 2) HIPAA ATO checklist 3) Audit log retention + format 4) KMS usage (customer-managed?) 5) Process for data deletion requests. Most can be answered by docs + small config work, some will require eng (audit stream export).

maria (PM): propose triage flow: quick pass = canned answers + doc links; medium = product + sec write clear spec + ship minor config; large = eng work + ETA. @taylor can you mark which items are "eng" vs "docs"?

taylor (Security): eng: audit streaming (S3/third-party), per-customer retention override, HSM/KMS integration QA. docs: SOC2 control mappings, encryption at rest/in transit writeups, incident response flows. HIPAA: need BAAs + DLP discussion.

jamie (Eng): FYI — audit streaming is ~2 sprint effort (API + async export + replay). retention override per-customer maybe 3-4 wks with migrations. HSM integration depends on KMS provider but smallish.

maria (PM): rough prioritization request: 1) SOC2 control mappings + docs (low effort) 2) audit log retention defaults + docs (low-med) 3) per-customer retention override (med-high) 4) audit streaming export to S3 (high). Agree? 

raj (Sales): need a concrete commitment for items 1 and 2 by next Thu to keep the deal moving. If we can promise docs + default retention answer, they will proceed.

taylor (Security): I'll draft SOC2/HIPAA canned answers today. For retention default, propose: "audit_log_retention_days: 365" and retention policy text. cc @maria

maria (PM): great — @taylor please push drafts to the intake ticket. I'll create a product ticket and link.

jira-bot: Created PROD-4983: medihealth-compliance-questionnaire-triage — https://jira.redwood/browse/PROD-4983

alex (Support): added the customer doc to PROD-4983.

maria (PM): acceptance criteria for docs: 1) SOC2 control mapping doc linked in public enterprise FAQ 2) HIPAA BAA statement + next steps 3) retention policy snippet and default value in product FAQ 4) estimate and label for eng work in ticket. Once docs up, sales can move forward.

taylor (Security): publishing draft in #product-docs now. reactions welcome. :eyes:

raj (Sales): thanks team — will push for conditional LOI once we have those docs.

maria (PM): assigning owners in ticket. will reopen if any blockers. Thanks all. :pray:
